name: Stand-up summary for an absent manager; every blocker must survive

messages.content: Summarize the engineering stand-up notes for a manager who was absent. At most three bullet points. Every blocker mentioned in the notes must appear in your summary.

Stand-up 2026-09-07
- Priya: finished the CSV export rewrite, PR is in review. No blockers.
- Tom: still cannot test payments because the payment provider's sandbox has been down since Friday. Blocked.
- Ana: rotated the staging API keys; starting on the audit log UI today.
- Marcus: the data-processing agreement is still with Legal, so the Fabrikam onboarding cannot start. Blocked.
- Priya also reminded everyone the release freeze starts Thursday.
